C-LOCALE-MIN-TWIN-REMOVAL.IntentSummary: Remove the ten static/locales/*.min.json twins and the laws that keep them alive: the loader glob switches to the full tables (localeLoader.js), both parity tests retire (locale-keys' byte-parity block becomes an inverted ten-file guard keeping the three T-003 gates; updateNotice's sync test is deleted), seven dead filter clauses and stale regeneration comments go, release tools stop writing and validating twins, dead src/common/i18n.js is deleted, and every living graph/verification/context artifact naming twins (M-055/V-M-055, M-011/V-M-011, V-M-012, V-M-062, deployment.xml) is rewritten in the same bundle; order matters — twins are deleted before the loader switch so the *.json glob never matches a live .min.json.

MustPassCommand.Command: npx vitest run tests/renderer/i18n/ tests/renderer/release-normalize.test.js tests/renderer/release-materials.test.js tests/renderer/components/updateNotice.test.js tests/renderer/store/notification.test.ts tests/renderer/util/agent-prompt-rich.test.js tests/renderer/util/theme-contrast.test.js tests/renderer/util/theme-families-docs-macos.test.js tests/renderer/whatsNew/content.test.js
npm run build && CI=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/settings-tabs-content.spec.ts tests/e2e/table-ui-regressions.spec.ts --project=chromium

bash -c 'hits=$(git grep -Il "min.json" -- . ":(exclude).grace/changes" 2>/dev/null); unexpected=$(printf "%s
" "$hits" | grep -v "^tests/renderer/i18n/locale-keys.test.js$" | grep -v "^.gitignore$" | grep -v "^docs/development-plan.xml$" | grep -v "^$"); test -z "$unexpected" || { printf "UNEXPECTED min.json residue:
%s
" "$unexpected"; exit 1; }'

T-001.Title: Preflight: parallel gate and fact re-verification before the first write

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: PREFLIGHT GATE (before the first write of this plan): re-run grace lint --path . --parallel-preflight and sequence against whatever overlaps it reports (spec Constraint: re-run, not trusted); re-verify the two deletion-safety facts with a fresh repo-wide grep: zero importers of src/common/i18n.js (excluding node_modules and build output; the renderer's window.i18nUtils.loadTranslations is an unrelated symbol) and the R-6 governance inventory unchanged (graph/runtime.xml M-011 2823, 3051-3054, 3074; verification/runtime.xml 4135, 4964, 5153, 6192, 6690, 6789, 13010; .grace/context/deployment.xml:1067). Any drift from the spec's inventory is fixed in the spec's ownership model (extend the task list, do not silently expand scope). No source writes in this task.

T-002.Title: Delete the ten twins, guard the directory, retire the byte-parity law

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: git rm the ten static/locales/*.min.json; .gitignore gains the static/locales/*.min.json pattern (with a one-line comment naming the guard test); tests/renderer/i18n/locale-keys.test.js: the byte-parity it-block (lines 73-79) is replaced by a guard reading the directory with readdirSync and asserting (a) exactly the ten expected full tables by name and (b) no file matching *.min.json — a reintroduced twin fails naming the file; the three C-TITLEBAR-MODE-CHIPS T-003 gates (fifteen families, non-empty native copy, truncation range) stay byte-identical in their assertions; MODULE_CONTRACT PURPOSE rewritten to the guard (fifteen families; no twin law); MODULE_MAP and CHANGE_SUMMARY "seventeen" corrected to fifteen; LINKS refreshed from the active/ path to the archived bundle path .grace/changes/archive/C-TITLEBAR-MODE-CHIPS/spec.xml. Ordering rule: this lands before T-003 so the loader's new *.json glob never sees a live twin.

Verification.Command: npx vitest run tests/renderer/i18n/locale-keys.test.js && test $(ls static/locales/*.json | wc -l) -eq 10 && test -z "$(ls static/locales/*.min.json 2>/dev/null)"

T-003.Title: Switch the loader to the full tables

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: src/renderer/src/i18n/localeLoader.js: the import.meta.glob pattern changes from ../../../../static/locales/*.min.json to ../../../../static/locales/*.json; the LOADERS lookup-key template inside loadLocaleTable (line 36, `../../../../static/locales/${locale}.min.json`) switches to the same .json form in the same edit; codeOf strips the plain .json suffix; BUNDLED_LOCALES still resolves the same ten codes, loadLocaleTable keeps both fallbacks and both [i18n][loadLocaleTable] markers untouched; MODULE_CONTRACT PURPOSE/DEPENDS and the stale min.json comments in localeLoader.js, systemLocale.js (DEPENDS/keep-in-sync comments) and src/renderer/src/_shims/install-window-globals.js (the two comment lines) are updated to the full-table pipeline; VERSION bump and CHANGE_SUMMARY entry per file convention. English's static import in i18n/index.js is untouched.

T-005.Title: Release tools stop writing and validating twins

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tools/release-normalize.mjs: the PLAN_RELEASE_NORMALIZATION loop drops the minPath variable and its addChange — only the full sourcePath tables are written; tools/release-materials.mjs: the minifiedTables map is deleted, validateLocaleMaterials is called with the source tables alone, and the source-to-minified parity requirement inside it (stableJson comparison failing as MT_RELEASE_LOCALE_MIN_DRIFT) is removed deliberately; tests/renderer/release-normalize.test.js and tests/renderer/release-materials.test.js: fixtures stop creating .min.json twins (lines 110, 212, 226 and the fixture reader at release-materials.test.js:62-65) and assert the new twin-free change shape; both tools' MODULE_CONTRACT/CHANGE_SUMMARY headers updated if they name twins.

Immediately before deleting, re-run the importer grep (zero hits expected, node_modules and build output excluded); git rm src/common/i18n.js; no other file changes — the module has no MODULE_CONTRACT, graph entry or verification anchor of its own (verified at spec time, re-verified in T-001), so no governance artifact loses an owner; typecheck:ipc stays clean.
